title: Zesty Pancakes with Saudi-Style Syrup
description: Delicious pancakes with a twist of zesty flavor, topped with a sweet Saudi-style syrup.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine zesty mix, saudia, and rice flour.
Gradually add in water to form a smooth batter.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Drop 1/4 cup of batter onto the pan to form a pancake.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, prepare the Saudi-style syrup by heating saudia and water in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve pancakes with the syrup and enjoy!
